about: Traits: permanent grants. Orsino traits are generated into data/catalog/orsino/traits.json with their categories: lineage (given at birth by an ancestry), nature, affinity, character, feat, party and specialization (a school or domain with spell access). This file holds Kyr's own traits and adaptations.

rises_again.name: Rises Again
rises_again.description: Brought down, it may get up again: it saves against death as the company does, and rises (CO-05: a foe brought to nothing is otherwise dead).

source.notes: Kyr's own: for the kinds that rise again (a troll, some of the dead); no kind bears it yet.

bloodless.name: Bloodless
bloodless.description: Bare bone, with nothing in it to bleed.

source.notes: The skeletal's (srd-proving-cases.md case 53): Orsino's Bone Resilience less its half of every point's blow and twice of every club's, which the SRD skeleton's damage reduction 5/bludgeoning stands for.

deep_water.name: Of deep water
deep_water.description: It lies in deep water: there is nothing to knock it down onto, and the water is between it and whatever one would duck.

weapon_master.name: Weapon master
weapon_master.description: Knows where a blow should land: a critical on 19 or 20.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.description: Has fought long enough to do two things in the time others do one: a second action each turn.

unbroken.name: Unbroken

slippery.name: Slippery

killing_eye.name: Killing eye
killing_eye.description: Sees the gap in any guard: a critical on 18 to 20.

fleet.name: Fleet
fleet.description: Moves before others have thought to: +2 initiative and evasion 1.

diamond_body.name: Diamond body
diamond_body.description: Mind and body schooled against harm: +2 to every save.

far_seeing.name: Far-seeing
far_seeing.description: Reads what is meant behind what is said, and what is coming: Insight, and a steadier will.

source.notes: A perk chosen at creation, the gold: wisdom, insight, divination family of the Atlas's five (the owner, 26 November: perks organised by the Atlas's tones; OR-153). A first spike: each gives what a trait already carries (a skill, a modifier); the lens each will earn comes with compactification's earned surfaces.

mathematician.name: Mathematician
mathematician.description: Thinks number and pattern through to proof: +1 intelligence, Lockwork and Mathematics. Mathematical checks succeed by proof; unseen properties and safe operation still require evidence.

source.notes: A perk chosen at creation, the violet family of the Atlas's five: the mathematical (the owner, 26 November: puzzles that want equations or computation, solved by proof and so guaranteed; the relics, devices and inscriptions of the Mathematical Age, each an ancient wonder to investigate; of intelligence more than wisdom, taking perception's deductions much further). A first spike: it gives what a trait already carries; the lens it earns comes with compactification's earned surfaces.
